name: iobrpy-result
description: Adaptive scientific visualization and implementation-aware interpretation for all registered IOBRpy result functions except deside.

interface.shortDescription: Adaptively visualize and interpret IOBRpy outputs
interface.longDescription: Explore mixed result directories, distinguish confirmed IOBRpy outputs from likely, reusable, external, metadata, and unknown files, design result-specific editable scientific figures, and interpret results with method-aware caveats in English or Simplified Chinese selected from the current request. Excludes deside and the non-result ai orchestrator.
defaultPrompt: Use only the language of my current request, ask me to choose Python or R, then explore this IOBRpy result directory and design the most informative figure
Ask me to choose Python or R before creating a result-specific publication-ready TME figure
Explain the biological meaning and limitations of these IOBRpy outputs in my language without asking about Python or R
Create the requested figure and report the complete absolute path of every generated image
